test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Andaman and Nicobar Island group of India is an emergent part of which of the following submerged mountain range?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arakan Yoma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points____​__**

__
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar islands (a&n) are thought to be the emergent peaks of a submerged mountain range related to the **Arakan Yoma range** of mainland Burma.
 
• The islands include steep hills, and generally poor soil with little water holding capacity.
 
• Arakan yoma is the extension of the himalayas located in **Myanmar**.
 
• The Arakan Mountains are also known as the **Rakhine Mountains.**
 
• These are a mountain range in** western Myanmar**, between the coast of Rakhine State and the Central Myanmar Basin, in which the Irrawaddy River flows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Port Blair **is the capital of the Union Territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
 
• Lt. Governors of Andaman and Nicobar is **Admiral D K Joshi.**
